items.title: SD-e1 var-bar portfolio (sd_e1_var_bar_readout_crush): OFF / RSD / RSD+anchor(EP) / RSD+anchor(RC) -- fidelity anchor, same-start real-endpoint goal_proximity variance, goal-axis projection, both bars at every horizon
items.note: SD-e1 var-bar PORTFOLIO for registered question sd_e1_var_bar_readout_crush (GOV-FANOUT-1; user-ratified 2026-09-04 Q2: ONE new EXQ, not a lettered 1000a). 4 arms x 6 seeds (42,123,7,2024,17,31): ARM_OFF (1000's depth-0 single-step incumbent, verbatim), ARM_RSD (1000's ITEM 3 InfoNCE, verbatim), ARM_RSD_ANCHOR_EP (LEAD: InfoNCE + endpoint MSE at h=5 on the same K windows), ARM_RSD_ANCHOR_RC (InfoNCE + ITEM 2 rollout_consistency_loss H=5 decay 0.5 on the same K windows). The two anchor arms are ONE registered leg (H-fidelity-anchor) with its composition -- left open by the autopsy ('rollout_consistency_loss ... or plain endpoint MSE') -- de-aliased rather than picked (Step 2.5b verdict-aliasing audit: a null on one form must not read as 'anchoring fails'). ANCHOR DOSE IS GRADIENT-MATCHED per tick (w_t = ||grad InfoNCE|| / ||grad anchor|| over E1's params, clamped [1e-3,1e4]; ANCHOR_GRAD_AUTHORITY=1.0 = equal gradient authority), with anchor_engaged as a readiness precondition on the anchor arms -- see red-team #1 below for why a fixed unit weight was refused. All arms ITEM-1-ON, uniform TRAIN_WINDOW_H=5 trigger so e1_grad_steps_matched holds by construction (measured). READOUTS at every checkpoint h in {1,2,3,5,10,20,30} (registered set {1,5,10,20,30}): e1coe_score_var(h) and cr_ratio(h) with BOTH bars (0.002 / 0.1) read per h; centroid-norm band [0.75, 4/3] vs real (4b) and vs same-seed OFF; spread ratio vs real; REAL-ENDPOINT goal_proximity AND goal_distance VARIANCE per h (the recording gap, H-readout-saturation) on the from-reset Phase 4b set AND on a NEW same-start Phase 4d set (the 40 candidate sequences executed for real from the warmup snapshot via env deepcopy + agent latent-state restore, verified bit-exact against a straight continuation in the authoring probe; EVAL only); endpoint-fidelity MSE per (start, sequence) rollout-vs-branched-real; goal-axis projection fraction (real 4b / 4d / rollouts); E1-alone readout beside the hybrid at every h incl h=30 (980 scope clause, never gating). DECISION RULE (pre-registered, majority 4/6, h=1 for the label, every h recorded): Leg A per green anchor arm -- supported iff centroid_norm/real in band AND var >= 2x ARM_RSD's AND cr bar retained; declared-null disjuncts (centroid outside band; var within 2x) route as such; H-fidelity-anchor ELIMINATED only if BOTH anchor arms are green and both sit on a null disjunct (else '_partial', mixed). Leg B (arm-invariant): same-start real-endpoint goal_proximity var(h=1) >= 0.002 on majority -> realvar_reaches_bar (eliminated); < on majority -> realvar_below_bar (supported: the bar is an instrument target to re-register); from-reset 4b reading recorded beside (upper bound). Leg C: ARM_RSD goal-axis fraction / real within 2x on majority -> eliminated; < 0.5x -> rsd_goal_orthogonal (supported). label = '<A>__<B>__<C>'; substrate_not_ready_requeue only when NO arm passes its own gate. PER-ARM GATES via experiments/_lib/precondition_gate.py (non_degenerate = any arm green; no red arm vacates another): 1000's eight + branched_same_start_nondegenerate_h1 + anchor_engaged; rsd_action_sensitive (1000 red-team identity-shortcut control) gates ARM_RSD ONLY, the anchor arms' ratios are recorded non-adjudicating (a lost sensitivity there is a RESULT of the anchor, read via cr_bar_retained). DV_HEADROOM DECLARED: kind 'dv_headroom' (experiments/_metrics.dv_headroom_check), dv e1coe_score_var_h1 vs C3_VAR_THRESHOLD 0.002 x margin 1.0, control = SAME-START real endpoints' goal_proximity variance at h=1 (majority-order over seeds; from-reset value recorded beside), emitted in interpretation.recorded_preconditions -- RECORDED, NOT ADJUDICATING, deliberately: an unmet headroom here IS the registered H-readout-saturation finding (the bar exceeds what real endpoints produce at real spread), routed by the confirmed autopsy to 're-register the bar', not to substrate_not_ready_requeue; a flat preconditions[] entry would adjudicate the whole run precondition_unmet on the very outcome the portfolio predicts (confirmed against build_experiment_indexes._compute_adjudication on the dry manifest: recorded -> 'verified' with the finding surfaced; negative control with the entry in preconditions[] -> 'precondition_unmet'). DV-SYMMETRY (per arm): ARM_OFF / ARM_RSD / ARM_RSD_ANCHOR_EP / ARM_RSD_ANCHOR_RC each change E1's learned weights, which move the 40 rollout endpoints non-uniformly -- neither a broadcast constant nor a monotone rescaling nor a permutation of the candidate index -- so every DV (variance of a bounded nonlinear readout, centroid-norm ratio, spread ratio, goal-axis fraction, fidelity MSE) is reachable; cr_ratio alone is scale-free and blind to a shrunk centroid (1000 learning #4), which is exactly why the centroid band and the centroid-corrected cr_ratio are read beside it. Leg B's DV is a measurement of real endpoints, arm-independent by design. Step 2.4 (GOV-REUSE-1): decisive readouts (a) real-endpoint goal_proximity variance per horizon -- reanalysis_query: 0 manifests carry it; 1000's manifest stores only cr_real spread/centroid/n, not endpoint vectors, so it is not derivable (the autopsy names this as the recording gap); (b) e1coe_score_var(h=1) on an anchored RSD arm -- no such arm has ever run. Not recoverable -> run. Step 2.5/2.5a: ITEM 1/2/3 IMPLEMENTED (ree-v3/CLAUDE.md; SD entry implementation_log 1-3); authoring probe against the working tree confirmed rollout_sequence_divergence_loss / rollout_consistency_loss / predict_long_horizon accept the [K,...] shapes used, the composed loss back-propagates into E1 (30/32 params), and the latent-state-restore branching reproduces a straight continuation to 0.0. Step 2.5b: claim_ids []. Brake counts on the unblocks claims: MECH-135 1 (108a), INV-088 2 (MECH-457 fanout autopsies 750/754 -- different mechanism, different substrate). New EXQ number, diagnostic portfolio answering an explicit fanout_recommendation on substrate enriched since (ITEM 3 landed 2026-09-03): not the re-derive loop. Step 2.5c: SD-e1-rollout-consistency-training (corrupting; e1_deep.py::forward/::predict_long_horizon) is this run's OWN target, the sanctioned exception per its item-2/3 substrate_gate_notes. Other open corrupting entries: contextmemory-write-path (ContextMemory.write called only from agent.py select_action/update paths, sd016_writepath_mode default off; never from sense() or the direct E1 calls here); mode-governance-engagement (use_salience_coordinator default False, _et_commit is in the E3 tick path, no select_action call); SD-082 (use_lateral_pfc_analog default False, compute_bias unreachable). None on this driver's path. Step 3.5: ASCII-only (0 non-ASCII); validate_experiments.py --strict OK, 0 warnings; validate_recording.py --strict OK on the dry manifest. Two authoring bugs caught and fixed before smoke: assert_no_structurally_unsatisfiable_gate takes a SEQUENCE of arm contexts with arm_id_key (was passed the dict); criteria_by_arm dict-key collision when ref_arm == RSD_ARM. Step 4 (--dry-run smoke, 2 seeds x 4 arms x 2 eps x 50 steps, 12 sequences, h<=10, 11 s): all 8 cells ran Phase 0a/0b/1/2/3/4/4b/4d/4c to completion; e1_grad_step_gap 0/0; rsd_engaged_frac 1.0 on every RSD arm; anchor_engaged authority 1.0 on both anchor arms (raw grad ratios 14-104x, i.e. the fixed-unit-weight dose would have been 1-7% of the update even at smoke scale); ARM_RSD correctly RED on rsd_action_sensitive at smoke scale (1.005/1.009 vs 1.05 -- untrained, the gate is reachable and fires; 1000's full run cleared it at 1.32-1.52), so the smoke label reads anchor_undetermined_arm_red__realvar_below_bar__rsd_goal_axis_undetermined_arm_red with ARM_OFF + both anchor arms green and scored (precondition_gate semantics working as designed). Same-start real goal_proximity var(h=1) at smoke scale 2.7e-06 (from-reset 2.7e-05) vs the 0.002 bar -- the leg-B reading the autopsy predicts; the full run decides. POSITIVE CONTROL (scratch harness, floor lowered to 1.0 in the harness only, n_train=3): all four arms green, label anchor_restores_centroid_var_flat__realvar_below_bar__rsd_goal_axis_mixed, every leg-A/B/C code path exercised, 34 adjudicating + 3 recorded preconditions, manifest JSON-serialisable. Step 4.5 red-team (model: fable, claude-fable-5-1, separate agent, one pass): CONTESTED, 7 findings, all dispositioned. #1 HIGH (manipulation cannot reach DV): at a fixed w=1.0 the anchor's gradient norm on E1's params is 45-71x smaller than the InfoNCE's once trained (reviewer probe; reproduced by the author at 30 eps: 59x EP / 45x RC) so a Leg-A null could not be told from 'never dosed' -> FIXED: gradient-matched per-tick dose (equal authority) + anchor_engaged readiness precondition + raw ratio recorded; stated limitation kept: the EP anchor constrains h=5 only while the label reads h=1 (the RC form weights step 1 most, so the two forms bracket it). #2 HIGH (verdict grid): the non-gating dv_headroom entry in interpretation.preconditions[] would adjudicate the whole run precondition_unmet (indexer reads preconditions[] flat, ignores gating:false) on the very outcome the portfolio predicts -> FIXED: moved to interpretation.recorded_preconditions[] (the indexer's non-adjudicating sibling channel, build_experiment_indexes._recorded_precondition_findings) with preconditions_scope_note; confirmed on the dry manifest ('verified', finding surfaced) and by negative control. #3 MEDIUM (criterion cannot discriminate): Leg B read from-reset (4b) endpoints while the bar applies to 40 rollouts fanning from ONE start (at h=1 at most n_actions distinct endpoints; 4b adds start dispersion, ~10x higher at smoke scale) -> FIXED: leg B and dv_headroom route on the SAME-START Phase 4d set; the registry-named 4b set is recorded beside as an upper bound. #4 MEDIUM (verdict grid): H-fidelity-anchor could be ELIMINATED on one green anchor arm when the other was red, and rsd_action_sensitive gated the anchor arms on their own trained InfoNCE (the manipulation moving its own gate) -> FIXED: elimination requires both anchor arms green (else '_partial', mixed); rsd_action_sensitive gates ARM_RSD only, anchor-arm ratios recorded. #5 LOW: two null readings could yield anchor_mixed -> FIXED: all three declared-null readings count. #6 LOW: cr_bar_retained never conditioned 'supported' -> FIXED: supported requires it; new reading centroid_restored_var_lifted_cr_bar_lost. #7 LOW (gate certifies own subject): a buffer-starved tick (no backward) counted as an E1 step -> n_e1_grad_steps_real recorded beside the counter (1 tick per seed, parity kept as in 1000). Reviewer's 'checked and clear' list: anchors back-propagate; h=1 hybrid readout equals training step 1; leg B arm-invariance holds empirically; 2.5c ContextMemory note stands; centroid band cleanly separates 1000's populations (OFF/real 0.985-1.223 in band, RSD/real 0.288-0.582 out); sensitivity floor has margin vs 1000's ARM_RSD. Not re-spawned: the verdict was CONTESTED, not BLOCKING. Mint-as-you-go: ARM_OFF emitted include_driver_script_in_hash=False (1000 convention; trips substrate_stable_across_run by construction -- read substrate_stability_detail.process_snapshot_drift, 1000 learning #6). Priority 60 (CURRENT_FRONT.md critical-path item 1; campaign W3-C1 item 1, chip-20260904-sde1-var-bar-portfolio). Cross-machine-class safe: no torch.multinomial anywhere. hypothesis_space_qid sd_e1_var_bar_readout_crush tagged in the manifest; the driver drafts hypothesis_space_ledger_proposal from the pre-registered rule for governance to adjudicate (the registry's distance_phrase 'portfolio not yet queued' is governance's to update). Compute: 1000's 4x6 grid ran 904 s on ree-cloud-2; this adds one extra rollout + two autograd.grad norms per anchored tick on two arms and the branched eval, est. 30 min.
